item.title: Raw milk can cause a variety of illnesses and infections. Some Michigan lawmakers want to legalize it anyway
item.description: Michigan is debating whether to loosen its restrictions on raw milk sales, which could potentially lead to increased risk of disease outbreaks due to the presence of dangerous bacteria in unpasteurized milk.

item.title: Records show lobbyists spent $485K on meals, trips for Michigan officials in 2025
item.description: Lobbyists in Michigan spent nearly half a million dollars wining and dining public officials in 2025, with some lawmakers receiving more than $12,000 in meals and travel expenses.
